image_description: An outdoor, semi-enclosed lumber processing scene featuring three men operating a portable sawmill. The structure has a corrugated metal roof supported by wooden posts. In the foreground, two men are feeding a large log into a band saw mechanism, while a third man in a hard hat supervises or waits. Stacks of processed lumber and raw logs are visible in the background, along with a blue pickup truck.
